title: Hadamard Matrix Existence Conjecture
summary: At the time of writing, dimension 668 was the smallest unresolved case; prove or disprove existence in every positive dimension divisible by four.

formal_statement.body: Prove or disprove: For every $N\in\mathbb{Z}_{>0}$, if $4\mid N$, then there exists a Hadamard matrix of dimension $N$.

assumptions: N is a positive integer divisible by 4.
parameters: N: dimension of the Hadamard matrix
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether a Hadamard matrix exists in every positive dimension divisible by 4.

citations.label: Simon's Algorithm and Symmetric Crypto: Generalizations and Automatized Applications

progress.summary: The paper presents this as a famous conjecture that remains open and notes that 668 was the smallest qualifying dimension for which no Hadamard matrix was known at the time of writing.
citation_labels: Federico Canale et al., Simon's Algorithm and Symmetric Crypto: Generalizations and Automatized Applications
